issues.message:
Restore protected source content:
protected node 24: expected ["code","sql",null,"-- Using the current time zone (assuming +08:00) to convert a time string without time zone information
select cast("2020-01-01 00:00:00" as timestamptz);"]; received ["code","sql",null,"-- 現在のタイムゾーン（+08:00 と仮定）を使用して、タイムゾーン情報のない時間文字列を変換
select cast("2020-01-01 00:00:00" as timestamptz);"]
protected node 26: expected ["code","sql",null,"-- TIMESTAMPTZ supports microseconds
select cast("2020-01-01 00:00:00.123456" as timestamptz(5));"]; received ["code","sql",null,"-- TIMESTAMPTZ はマイクロ秒をサポート
select cast("2020-01-01 00:00:00.123456" as timestamptz(5));"]
protected node 28: expected ["code","sql",null,"-- Using a time string with time zone information
select cast("2020-01-01 00:00:00 +03:00" as timestamptz);"]; received ["code","sql",null,"-- タイムゾーン情報を含む時間文字列を使用
select cast("2020-01-01 00:00:00 +03:00" as timestamptz);"]
